newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates narrow to 3.50-4.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates narrow to 3.50-4.50 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar traded on Tuesday in a slightly narrower 3.50-4.50 percent range as public sector wages entering the banking system helped further flood the market, bankers said.

Bankers atr=tributed softer rates this week to both lower than expected subscription in the latest 15 million dinar ($21 million) CD (certificate of deposits) issue and start of monthly salary transfers by state ministries.
Rates hovered in a 3.00-4.75 percent range on Monday.
